_description: Retrieval-quality baseline for HybridRetriever (issue #377). Initial values seeded as placeholders under the 'first-run blesses' strategy — see PR body. The harness compares current aggregate metrics against these baselines and fails if regression exceeds the documented tolerances. When tightening the baseline (after corpus-seeding follow-up lands), update both this file and the workflow comment; do NOT loosen tolerances to mask a regression.

recall_at_10._tolerance_rationale: 5pp default — common MTEB / BEIR convention for retrieval-regression gating (Thakur et al. 2021 §5.3 cites ~3-5pp as typical noise floor on labeled query-sets of this size). Document as 'default, tighten on signal' until the corpus-seeding follow-up issue lands and we have a non-zero baseline.

mrr._tolerance_rationale: 0.05 absolute — issue #377 §D specifies 'MRR no more than -0.05' verbatim. Adopted as initial gate; revisit after first non-zero baseline.
